name: The Pit
description: When a mafia family named Koçovars are in danger of losing control of their neighborhood, “The Pit,” their youngest son must come back home, a place he could never truly escape.

videos.title: Season 1 and 2 Special Episode
videos.overview: Season 1 and 2 special episode of Çukur with Emmi's narration.

videos.title: The Pit at Home
videos.overview: Unable to solve his problems with his brothers, Yamaç will consult Vartolu to find a solution. Yamaç, who asks for help from an old friend with the idea he got from Vartolu, will not get the reaction he wants from Cumali and Selim. While the Koçovalı brothers decide to solve their problems in their own way, Vartolu in prison will not be able to intervene in what is happening. Azer and Karaca, who continue their secret meetings, will have to make a decision. Akın will take a step to get closer to Songül. As the Koçovalı brothers try to solve their other problems, the new information they will reach about their new enemy Arık Böke Erdenet will be a matter of curiosity.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Pit (Ç​ukur), that İdris Koçovalı has built with his own hands, is the heart of İstanbul; in fact it is Istanbul! There's no room for any danger that could threaten the neighborhood. Yamaç is a daytime chemist and a nighttime musician who has ran away from this neighborhood years ago for some reason. The young man's life changes as their paths cross with Sena who is a feisty personality like himself. While the two of them are dragged into a passionate love affair; Çukur is on the verge of a storm with Vartolu's arrival. The same storm will drag Yamaç towards The Pit and his past that he has abandoned a long time ago. After all everybody will ultimately return to The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Yamac takes a new turn in his life. His brother Kahraman was murdered. His father has been taken to the hospital. War begins between Vartolu and his men and the pit. Yamac's mind is in Sena at the same time. Sena goes to Izmir next to her family. However, they will meet soon and find themselves in great danger.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Vartolu is determined to destroy every obstacle in front of him. But he is also unaware that he hit a hard rock like Yamac. Yamac will bring Sena to your father's house after the attack. In the Sultan's eyes, Sena and Sultan, who are regarded as the people to disrupt the order of the family, face each other. Meanwhile, Yamac is willing to make peace with Vartolu. While a surprise name will witness this moment of peace, the balances between Yamac and Selim will also change completely.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Idris finally opens his eyes. A whole new era begins in the pit. The reaction of Idris, who sees Yamac at home, will be tougher than predicted. The great confrontation between the father and the son will overturn all the balances in the pit. Idris, who met Sena, learns that she is the wife of Yamac. Yamac not only struggles with the turbulent period at home, but also tries to find the traitor among them. Yamac's interest in the collection of the singer named Dogukan dragged him to the very heart of a great danger.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Yamaç is determined to find the traitor among them at any cost. However, there is a big obstacle in front of him. It will be much more difficult for Yamaç to convince Idris, who sees everyone as one of the family, of this possibility than finding the traitor. The tension between father and son gradually increases. Storms are also brewing among the Koçovalı women. Sena has no intention of following Sultan Koçovalı's rules. The moment she steps out of the four walls, someone she meets from the neighborhood will show her the true face of Çukur. Selim, who does not hesitate to put even those closest to him in the fire to prevent the truth about himself from being revealed, makes an irreversible mistake. Vartolu, who makes a quick entry into the neighborhood, takes steps to win the love of the residents of Çukur. Vartolu, who covets Idris Kochovali's place, will start the real war.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The tensions increasingly rise in The Pit. Yamac is even more suspicious after Isa's death. Despite respecting them as uncles, Emmi and Pasa become the head suspects for Yamac after the raid on the gun shipment. There will be permanent hierarchy changes in the already boiling neighborhood The Pit. Finding herself in a very different world, Sena sees Yamaç's other side and faces the biggest shock of her life. The mutual agreement between Selim and Vartolu changes. Celasun decides to rob a gun warehouse which belongs to the Koçovali family after finding out that his siblings are hungry. This move of his will bring him face to face with Yamac. Vartolu makes a move to go up the ranks in the neighborhood and starts planning a surprise which will enrage Yamaç.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Everything will change when Idris returns to the neighborhood and reminds his domination. Vartolu has no intention to step back. He's determined to undermine the Pit and rule the neighborhood. The ultimate challenge begins now. Yamaç will surprisingly find Vartolu's weak spot thanks to barber Muhittin. As Selim gets prepared for his new move during the storm in the Koçovali family and the neighborhood, Vartolu will shock the viewers with his best shot.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Tension reaches its peak at The Pit neighborhood where everybody's playing by their own rules. Yamaç has found Vartolu's weak spot and has made his last shot to finish the game. Vartolu is going to give Idris and Yamaç the surprise of a lifetime in return for the unexpected blow he has received. Idris will question why Yamaç is not responding to this and will give him a life lesson. In the meantime, one of the underworld men Serdar will raise the tension when he comes to Selim's illegal gambling place. There's also a storm brewing among the women of the Koçovali family. Sultan has made up her mind. Sena is going to leave this house.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Yamaç will face the ultimate test of his life. On one side his father Idirs and on the other side the woman he loves, Sena are in danger. Yamaç's reaction towards this event will surprise everyone especially Serdar. Selim who kidnaps Sena will get cornered. Vartolu and Celasun are kept in the bingo saloon by Serdar's men and they try to escape with Celasun's dangerous plan. But Celasun's plan harms an unexpected person during the moment that we hold our breaths. In the meantime; Serdar who sees that Yamaç is a tough guy, orders his men to attack The Pit. Idris's house is one of the targets. Yamaç takes action as he realizes that Serdar won't give up. In this moment of gun shots, the viewers will curiously wait to see who's down the barrel.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Yamaç, Sena and Serdar are in front of the bullet. One of them gets shot, but who? Meanwhile a great threat is awaiting the Koçovali women. Serdar's men raid Idris's house. Sultan and the other women's' fates depend on Vartolu who appears there at the time. Karaca's condition is critical after risking her life for Celasun. Selim is having a hard time against Yamaç and he's determined to make Serdar pay for having been cornered. Just when the tension rises, Yamaç faces one of the most difficult decisions of his life after Baykal's move to corner him.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The balance in The Pit has been disrupted. The struggle between Vartolu and Yamaç gets tense. The battle lines are drawn between them. In addition to this high tension confrontation Yamaç has to make a choice between Sena and The Pit. He's having the toughest time of his life. Selim is humiliated before Yamaç. He loses his temper and leads Yamaç to an almost irreversible mistake. In the meantime, Baykal and Lawyer Nazim will be busy with making dangerous moves. During the tense moments Idris will receive a mysterious letter that will start a new era in The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: While Baykal's moves are ticking, Yamac focuses on finding the traitor inside. Idris is determined to open the background of the past after the letter he received. Sultan makes a dangerous move and asks Pasa to help. Yamac is destroyed by the news of divorce from Sena. They will change everything.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: There is a great confrontation in the pit that will upset the balances. Idris Kocovali and Vartolu are now opposed. Idris, who learns that his son is alive, follows him. Yamac is very close to resolving Vartolu's identity. While Sena tries to escape from the pit and leave everything behind, Cukur realizes that she needs it. Feeling that Yamac is approaching his goal, Vartolu will face the risk of losing everything on his own, even if he has various kinds of obstacles in front of him.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: No secret can be hidden forever. There is an exciting period in the pit where great confrontations will take place. In the pit life will no longer be the same for anyone. The hillside learns that Vartolu is his brother. In the face of this great development that will upset your life, what is going to happen to Yamac is curious; the sins of the past will not leave a stone on the stone in The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: It’s the time of reckoning in The Pit! Yamaç is messed up with the disappointment and shock of learning that Vartolu is his brother. A storm is about to break between Yamaç who has confronted his father’s past and İdris. İdris realizes that he was stabbed in the back by the ones who are closest to him and thinks about his next move. Will he be merciful and understanding, or will he take everything down stone by stone? Nothing is the same in The Pit anymore and trust among the neighborhood and the Koçovalı family is shaken. In this tense episode we will curiously wait to see if Vartolu and İdris are going to confront each other.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The past has been revealed; A storm is approaching The Pit. A series of confrontation where everybody will face themselves and each other continues at full speed. Yamaç is stuck between the truth he knows and his father’s order “Vartolu will go away from The Pit” and he will live the hardest days of his life. On the other hand, Vartolu will choose between leaving forever with the love of his life Saadet or staying in The Pit and taking revenge for the past. The big duel between Yamaç and Vartolu will affect everybody’s lives.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The corpse that came out of Vartolu’s house will shift the balance forever. The series of confrontation in The Pit will be really tough. An intruder who comes to The Pit will brew up a storm. Nobody is aware of what is awaiting them... Especially Yamaç, Sena and İdris. A turbulent period that will shift the balance is starting in The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: With Inspector Emrah’s arrival to The Pit the Koçovalı family will have a new enemy. While İdris is struggling to get rid of a new threat, Yamaç will meet his new enemy. Sena will be traumatized by Inspector Emrah who is also her brother. While Sena faces her past fears, everything will change when Selim throws himself in front of the bullets. Meanwhile İdris will live a shock and regret with the surprise of a lifetime.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Selim is fighting for his life after jumping right in front of his brother Yamaç and taking a bullet. While the Koçovalı family is shaken with this sad event the past will haunt them. Sena is having the toughest period of her life with Emrah’s arrival. She will come back from İzmir with a big surprise and this will change the tide of the events. Will the curiosity about the conclusion of Selim’s fight for life continues, Vartolu and Yamaç’s confrontation will deeply affect both ends. The real confrontation for Vartolu who feels rage and sadness at the same time will be the one with İdris who will call him by his real name Salih.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The Pit is winded and the eyes are focused on İdris and Vartolu; the father and son that reunite after all those years. Vartolu has two options: living what he has missed as Salih Koçovalı or continuing to storm out in ‘The Pit’ as ‘Sadettin from Varto’. As Vartolu is at a challenging stage of his life Yamaç goes crazy when he learns that Selim got hit by Baykal and takes action. In this episode where the balance is disrupted Baykal threatens everybody around him and causes an irreversible pain for Yamaç. Alarm bells are ringing for everyone in The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The return of Vartolu is not only for the pit but also for Baykal. Feeling himself trapped, Yamaç will make a surprising business alliance to get the revenge of those who go.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: There will be consequences for the game Vartolu and the Koçovalı’s played against Baykal. A formidable enemy is awaiting Yamaç and İdris in The Pit where the real challenge begins. Elvis has taken sides against the Koçovalı’s to save Baykal and has caused a new storm. Aliço will confront his past while seeking for Hale’s revenge. On the other hand, Nazım will follow his plan to repair his damaged pride.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Elvis makes a daring move and kidnaps the Koçovalı women. Yamaç and Vartolu turn mad with this dangerous move. Elvis and his gang will not stop until they get Baykal. After a tough struggle of gun shots, the Koçovalı women are saved by an unexpected person. The future of Yamaç and Vartolu’s cooperation will raise questions. In this episode where the cards will be dealt again, we will anxiously wait to see how Elvis will be stopped.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Saadet’s innocent love for Vartolu causes a vital incident within the Koçovalı household. Nedret’s seek for revenge leads her to Vartolu’s house with a gun in her hand. But Sultan gets hit by the bullet in the wrong time and place. The stray bullet destroys the Koçovalı family. As Sultan fights for her life Nazım’s next step after pulling all the strings with Elvis and Baykal’s death will rise curiosity. On the other hand, how will the truth that Yamaç has learned from Emrah effect his relationship with Sena? As secrets are revealed and new confrontations take place in ‘The Pit’ we will breathlessly wait to see the course of the struggle.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: New sides are formed in The Pit. Sultan’s shooting escalates the fight between the Koçovalı family and Vartolu-Medet. Sultan’s legs are paralyzed and her decision is clear; Medet, who put her there must be killed. The gun that is pulled during Sultan and Medet’s confrontation will cause tension. We will curiously wait to see what Yamaç will do after being caught between Sultan and Medet. The unfortunate events unite the Koçovalı family at the same table after a long time. Vartolu has become the scapegoat after Sultan’s incident and he makes a move to gain back his power. The side he will choose after meeting Nazım and Emrah will revive the past struggle.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: The alliance between Vartolu, Nazım and Emrah is the beginning of a new battle. İdris Koçovalı has offered Vartolu two choices; Vartolu will either become Salih and marry Saadet or remain as Vartolu and will turn The Pit against him. But an unexpected surprise is awaiting İdris. Some of The Pit’s men are standing by Vartolu. While Yamaç is worried about the consequences of this union Sena makes a move and knocks the door of an unexpected person. Balance has shifted in The Pit and a big danger will traumatize a lot of people including Yamaç.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: The Pit is being driven to the brink. The fight between the Koçovalı’s and Vartolu is now continuing between İdris Koçovalı and Vartolu. While Vartolu is making moves to get The Pit he takes the big hit from İdris Koçovalı. İdris has decided to arrange Saadet’s marriage and invites everyone in the middle of the neighborhood. In the meantime, Yamaç is trying to keep the balance between Vartolu and his father and solve their problems with Sena. But unspoken secrets will cause them to fall apart. On the other hand, we will breathlessly wait to see the consequences of Selim’s decision to collaborate with Emrah, Nazım and Vartolu and where it will lead The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Six episodes before the season finale the big fight begins in The Pit. After helping Sena, Vartolu turns Yamaç against him in addition to İdris Koçovalı and causes him to become Yamaç’s biggest enemy. Yamaç calls Sena and Vartolu to account. This confrontation is also the beginning of major developments. Vartolu does everything he can to prevent Saadet’s marriage. But a fatal mistake alienates Saadet. On the day of the wedding an unexpected incident turns everything upside down.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: When Selim murders Cemil adds a new one to the realities of The Pit. As we curiously wait to see if Selim will pay for his fatal mistake everybody in the Koçovalı family is shocked with the sudden cancellation of the wedding. The partnership between Vartolu, Selim, Emrah and Nazım grows stronger. How Yamaç will be affected from this secret alliance is a big question. Five episodes before the season finale the residents of The Pit will confront each other while Yamaç and his men will be dragged into a dangerous surprise in the weapons depot.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Yamaç, Selim, Emmi and Paşa who are trapped inside the cold storage unit are struggling to survive. An unexpected incident during the moments of high tension helps them get saved. Yamaç is out of danger but he’s worried about Sena. Ezgi’s cure under the threat of Emrah causes Sena to get worse every passing day. In the meantime; İdris and Vartolu’s being taken hostage raises the tension. While Vartolu’s unexpected move appears to have broken the ice, the incidents that take place in jail are the signals of a serious storm coming.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Yamaç and his men are in a race against time. In this episode where breaths are held they are about to lose The Pit and their only way out is to find money. Yamaç doesn’t give up and he starts a big game. As the winner of this game will raises curiosity, Yamaç is worried about Sena’s situation and he asks for Saadet’s help. Having started a war against the Koçovalı family, Vartolu will encounter unexpected surprises. Selim on the other hand will continue to be the buffer zone between two sides so that their alliance is not revealed. The big truth that one of the Koçovalı’s will learn, is going to be the beginning of the real challenge.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Two episodes before the big season finale everything will shake up in The Pit. The Koçovalı’s are about to lose The Pit. Having been challenged by Vartolu, İdris Koçovalı will live the shock of his life. İdris Koçovalı’s reaction to Selim’s being on Vartolu’s side will be a big question mark. In the meantime; an unexpected incident in the neighborhood will lead Yamaç and Vartolu to fight back together. Some happy news in the Koçovalı family will put a smile on everybody’s face. While Selim’s proposal to his father will shock the viewers, the Koçovalı family will be desperate about saving The Pit from Nazım, Emrah, Vartolu and Selim who have joined forces.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: A storm is about to break in The Pit on the season finale. The Pit will get stuck in the middle of Koçovalı’s and Vartolu’s sides. Having experienced the worst destruction after his son Selim’s betrayal, İdris Koçovalı will accept his defeat and leave The Pit to Vartolu. As Yamaç continues to fight, Akşın and Celasun’s wedding will be like a fresh breath for the Koçovalı’s. In the season finale of The Pit where the tension will peak each character’s own finale will shock everyone.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: It's the end of an era in The Pit. The condition of the Koçovalı's who lost power after an unexpected attack is still unclear. In the meantime, the Dark Sheep gang ruled by Çeto (Erkan Avcı) and Mahsun (Berkay Ateş) will start a new era in The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: As the Dark Sheep enjoy their dominance in The Pit Cumali will unexpectedly escape from prison and shift the balance in the neighborhood. Having sworn revenge, Cumali will confront his brother Yamaç after long years and will make a move against the Dark Sheep. On the other hand, Yamaç who is still shocked with the destruction will join the challenge to gather his family and The Pit together. Everything will change when Vartolu gets in the game. In this thrilling episode the mysterious character of the Dark Sheep Ersoy will address the neighborhood. As Sena struggles to get over with Vartolu's confession, the war between the Dark Sheep and the Koçovalı's will get heated.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Yamaç is determined to take back The Pit from Dark Sheep. And he asks for one chance from Cumali; if they cannot collect the The Pit in their own way, they will follow Cumali's road.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Yamaç, Vartolu and Cumali have joined forces. The Koçovalı brothers take action to regain The Pit. But the tension between Cumali and Vartolu will make things difficult for Yamaç. As Yamaç continues to struggle for his purpose, he also gets stuck between Cumali and Vartolu. While the Koçovalı brothers continue to fight shoulder to shoulder despite the hurdles; one of the brothers will unexpectedly confront İdris.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: The Koçovalı’s have been defeated by the Dark Sheep but they will soon recover and attack. Whatever It takes, Selim will do every possible thing to contact his father İdris. Aliço’s unexpected visit to İdris will be the beginning of the upcoming storm. When Sultan hears İdris’s ex-love Meliha’s name, the tension will get high. We’ll curiously wait for the moment Cumali and Yıldız meet. In the meantime, The Koçovalı’s will encounter a new dangerous threat.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: The Koçovalı's and the Dark Sheep now have a common enemy. After Seyfettin Kadı kidnaps Cumali and Çeto, both sides will go mad. In the meantime; being kept in separate rooms, Cumali and Çeto will become sidekicks. Mete's ending up inn the hospital will be the last straw for Celasun. As Celasun's anger at Meke grows, their confrontation will elevate the adrenaline. By the way Yamaç asks Aliço's help to organize Vartolu, Medet, Metin and Kemal in order to make a plan for rescuing Cumali. But it won't be easy to reach his goal. Mahsun and Ersoy's plan to rescue Çeto will unexpectedly endanger the life of two brothers.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Yamaç will go mad after Vartolu doesn't listen to him and gets caught. Now he will have to rescue Vartolu too. Yamaç takes Metin and Kemal along and makes a move. Mahsun will make a plan to rescue Çeto but he will unexpectedly encounter Yamaç. Karaca will ask Sena's help in this challenging episode. The viewers will experience emotional moments when Selim encounters İdris.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Yamaç finds Ersoy’s weak spot with the help of Aliço. Together with Vartolu they will come up with new plans to destroy the Dark Sheep. The question that Selim has been wondering for years will take İdris to the past. During the confrontation between father and son İdris will make confessions about Meliha. We will curiously wait for the moment İdris and Meliha come face to face. While Celasun, Ayşe and Karaca search for Akşın; the troubles he has messed with will corner Celasun. Sena will tell Yamaç about Akşın’s situation and that Karaca asked for her help. Once again Cumali will not listen to Yamaç and will go his own way. Celasun will find himself in the middle of a game that will affect the fight between the Koçovalı’s and the Dark Sheep.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: As Cumali is unaware that Celasun is pointing a gun at him, the two of them will come face to face and a breathtaking chase will start on the roofs of The Pit. After seeing Akşın Sena is determined to bring the family back together. She will try to get them to meet. İdris and Yamaç’s encounter will be full of emotions. On the other hand, Cumali will hesitate to see İdris. As Yamaç continues to take advantage of Ersoy’s wak spot, Çeto’s plans about Vartolu will lead him to a hard decision.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Çeto uses Saadet as a leverage and forces Salih to become Vartolu again. We will curiously wait to hear what Çeto will ask from Vartolu. While trying to learn the Dark Sheep’s plans through Ersoy, Yamaç unexpectedly encounters Veysel. Çeto will make new plans to use Vartolu and Celasun and their fight with the Koçovalı’s will get heated.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Yamaç is determined to chase Ersoy. The information he will get while cornering Ersoy will come with some secrets. And these secrets will give Yamaç a hard time. Vartolu will not give up on trying to find Saadet and he will try every way to reach the woman he loves and his unborn child. But we will wonder how long Vartolu will continue to work for the Dark Sheep behind Yamaç’s back. An emotional incident in The Pit will bring everyone together. When Yamaç is seen on the streets of The Pit, a question will come to the minds: ‘Will The Pit go back to its old days?’ Cumali’s encounter with his father İdris and his mother Sultan will bring the audience to tears. Cumali’s step will be a new hope for the Koçovalı’s.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: As Mahsun and Çeto play the Koçovalı’s they will be shocked to see that they unexpectedly became the prey. This will lead them to make ruthless plans for the Koçovalı’s. Vartolu, whose wife and newborn child were taken away from, will grant the Dark Sheep’s request. While chasing the chemist, Yamaç and Cumali will get closer to Vartolu with each step. We will curiously wait to see when Vartolu’s secret will be out. Selim gives a help and is appreciated by Emmi and İdris. Ersoy’s proposal to Yamaç will change everything between the Koçovalı’s and the Dark Sheep.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Yamaç and Cumali will go mad because the Dark Sheep have got the children of the Pit. The two of them together with Metin and Kemal will make a move to take back the children. But they were greeted with a surprise. Someone from the Pit will find out that Vartolu is working for Çeto to get Saadet and his son back, and will confront him. As we curiously wait to see who this is, Sultan will take Sena, Ayşe, Akşın and Karaca under her wings as Mother Sultan. In the meantime, Mahsun will make new plans to get closer to Sena. As Yamaç is suspicious about this neighbor who presents himself as “Fikret”, he will get information about Çeto and Mahsun from Ersoy. Cumali will get closer to his target because he won’t rest until he finds the man who works for Çeto.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: As Yamaç continues to get information from Ersoy, Ersoy’s plan to kill Çeto and Mahsun will lead them to an unexpected situation. The tension increases when Vartolu tell Çeto and Mahsun that there’s a traitor among them. In the meantime, Aliço gets a clue that will get Yamaç closer Vartolu’s secret. We will curiously wait for Selim and Sultan’s confrontation. On the other hand, İdris’s new step will shift the balance.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: The gunshots heard in ‘The Pit’ will be the messenger of a greater storm and will start a brand new era! The Dark Sheep will have to leave The Pit after their shocking losses. We’ll wait to see if the Koçovalı’s are taking over The Pit again? Although the Dark Sheep leave The Pit they will do whatever it takes to prevent anyone from entering the neighborhood. Yamaç will do everything he can to help his brother Vartolu when he finds out that Saadet and her baby are alive. In the meantime, the moment that Selim confronts Cumali will be full of emotions. The Koçovalı’s will enjoy the happiness of being together after a long time. When one of the main characters gets shot the balance will shift in The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Yamaç Koçovalı will struggle for his life after being seriously injured with the bullet impacts. After their losses the Koçovalı’s will be challenged with Yamaç’s injury. İdris will face the fear of losing another son. The Koçovalı brothers have taken action and they will struggle to find the traitor at any cost. After being forced to leave The Pit Çeto and Mahsun will account the ones who did this to them. Cumali and Emmi will return to The Pit but the neighborhood will be totally different from the way they remember it. The tension between Vartolu and Cumali will grow. Who shot Yamaç? Will The Pit be able to recover? We’ll curiously wait to learn the answers.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: As Yamaç’s struggle for life continues in the hospital the dust will not settle in The Pit. Although the Dark Sheep have left the neighborhood the tension among the kids of The Pit will continue to grow. Selim will face Sena and will confront the vital truth. Sultan is next to her son the whole time he’s in the hospital. Old wounds will rise to the surface when she encounters Meliha in the hospital. As Cumali is still mad at Vartolu the struggle between them will continue to grow. Vartolu realizes the situation of the neighborhood and asks Cumali to restore the order. In the meantime, he will continue to maintain control. While Mahsun is looking for Çeto in The Pit; Cumali and Vartolu Salih’s moment of encounter with the kids of The Pit will be interrupted with gunshots. Step by step we’ll get closer to the truth about who shot Yamaç.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: As the Koçovalı family is happy that Yamaç is feeling better, a decision that Yamaç takes will put him in danger again. Cumali and Vartolu will encounter an unexpected side of Sena. In the episode where the person who shot Yamaç will be exposed the unexpected surprise will shock the viewers. As Yamaç tries to recover while the tension between Salih and Cumali rises in addition to the situation in the neighborhood, Selim will become the bridge to maintain the balance. İdris will turn Salih and Cumali against each other to put an end to the struggle. Sena will confront Mahsun after finding out about the true identity of his neighbor. Meliha will confront Sultan after learning a great truth about her life. When Çeto shows up on one of the members of the Koçovalı family the course of the struggle will change.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: When İdris confronts Çeto, the murderer of his grandchild and daughter-in-law, Çeto's request will lead İdris to make a decision. As a conclusion of Yamaç and İdris's decision the Dark Sheep will return to The Pit. Cumali and Salih will react sharply and go mad. When Metin confronts Yamaç at the neighborhood's coffee house, the residents of The Pit will remember the good old days. The suspicions of the Koçovalı's about the existence of a force above the Dark Sheep will mount after Çeto's request. Cumali and Salih's step will lead them to an unexpected surprise. In this episode that tension will mount Yücel's identity will also be revealed.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: The Koçovalı's and the Dark Sheep will confront each other in The Pit. Thanks to Aliço, İdris will wear his suit and walk in the streets of The Pit just like the old days. The Koçovalı's will take action to get their jobs back with the impact of the sense of unity in the neighborhood. But each time, their encounter with the Dark Sheep will complicate things. The Koçovalı's will use Yücel as a leverage to find the name that's above Çeto and Mahsun.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: The secret that Yamaç finds out about Çeto will mount tension between the Koçovalı's and the Dark Sheep. Mahsun's unexpected visit to Sultan's soup kitchen will drive the residents of The Pit crazy. But Sultan's reaction to Mahsun's visit will be the real surprise. Uluç's daughter Damla will cross paths with the Koçovalı's. The challenge between Cumali and Damla will create tension. In this action-packed episode full of clashes, an important character will say goodbye to The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: The struggle between the Koçovalı's and the Dark Sheep will be interrupted by a gunshot. This shocking event will affect both sides. While Salih continues to move along with the Koçovalı's he will also play by his rules. The Koçovalı's will continue to trace the secrets of Çeto and Mahsun in order to find their weak spot. Mahsun will be shocked with the information on the file that Yamaç gives him and will secretly make a research to confirm it. We will curiously wait to see how the balance will shift between Mahsun and Çeto. The Dark Sheep will not only mess with the Koçovalı's; they will have a new target. There will be action in and out of The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Things in The Pit don’t calm down. Çeto will try to take revenge on the Koçovalıs after splitting ways with his closest; Mahsun. Cumali will try to take advantage of Çeto being newly weakened, and make plans to deliver the final blow on the Dark Sheep. An important secret Cumali discovers through Meke will put Çeto in a tough spot against the Koçovalıs. The surfacing of the name Baykal will turn heads. In the meantime Selim and Sena will discover more information on Mahsun’s past. The Pit will witness a surprise wedding after Akşın and Celasun’s wedding.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: The tornado between Çeto and Mahsun will also shape the future of the Dark Sheep. Koçovalıs make a move to find Baykal’s trace. The Koçovalıs will find themselves in a tough spot while trying to find a man they believe to be dead. Salih and İdris will have an important face off. The audience will drown to tears while watching what happens between the father and son. Selim and Sena will find a surprising person as well as information while tracing down Mahsun. While Çeto keeps making treacherous plans against Mahsun and the Koçovalı brothers, Idris unites with his sons to take the Pit to the good old days.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: This will be the last curtain on the struggle between the Dark Sheep and the Koçovalıs. On this action packed episode which will keep the audience baffled, Çeto will stop at nothing to destroy the Koçovalıs. Mahsun will move in to take revenge on both the Koçovalıs and Çeto.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: This time the neighborhood will unite to remove the traces of the struggle with the Dark Sheep from The Pit. The cops will come to The Pit a short while after finding out what happened and will not leave empty-handed. Sena’s disappearance will point all fingers at Mahsun. As everybody unites to find Sena, an unexpected character will come to help Vartolu.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Yamaç and Selim will race against time to find Sena. The man with the ring confronts Sena and carries out his unexpected plan which will shift the balance in The Pit forever. Uluç will make a move that will put the Koçovalıs in a tight spot by going behind them so that the precious stones fall into the hands of Sedat. A secret about İdris and Meliha’s past will reveal some evidence about the man with the ring. As Yamaç tracks Mahsun down the action-packed confrontation between the two of them will be breathtaking. Mahsun thinks that nothing can tear him and Sena apart but a big surprise is waiting for them.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Yamaç will unknowingly come side by side with the man with the ring. He will leave Yamaç a clue about Sena’s death and Yamaç will confront Meliha. Sedat’s death will give a new enemy to The Pit. While all eyes are turned towards the man with the ring, the Alligator will stir things up in The Pit to reach Yamaç and avenge Sedat’s death. In the episode where Vartolu Salih will go after the precious stones, Yamaç will surprisingly get a call from Baykal. Everybody will focus on the man with the ring and Baykal, while the Alligator’s confrontation with one of the Koçovalıs will end surprisingly.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: The shooting of the man who faked Baykal will leave Yamaç with unanswered questions. As Yamaç goes after the man with the ring their target will change when they find out that The Alligator has Cumali. Meanwhile, the man with the ring will not stay quiet and will continue to carry out his plans. Vartolu will surprisingly come for Cumali’s help and put himself in danger. The Koçovalı brothers fight side by side with Medet to break free. Idris and Meliha will go to Gül Music Hall after all those years and settle old scores. The identity of the man with the ring will be revealed. The Koçovalıs will face the fear of losing someone among them with his unexpected move.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: The news about Akşın’s kidnapping will shock The Pit. The Koçovalıs don’t have the strength to cope with another loss. They will do whatever it takes to find Akşın. Aliço will get closer to Akşın thanks to the clue left by the man with the ring. In the meantime, Vartolu will struggle with Savaş who is trying to do business with his own rules in The Pit. The confrontation of both sides will bring a new enemy for the Koçovalıs. Yamaç is shocked with the truth that Yücel is the man with the ring. Apart from Yamaç an unexpected character will also confront Yücel.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: During the confrontation of Yamaç and Aliço with Yücel Yamaç will go back to the starting point and will lose Yücel. In the meantime, İdris will confront Azer Kurtuluş, the brother of Savaş who died in Salih’s place. Cumali will learn something that will lead him to suspicion. Damla will also learn the same thing through a different way. This will lead the two of them to a difficult situation. The Koçovalıs together with Aliço, Emmi, Medet, Metin and Kemal will join forces to stop Azer. But Azer will show them that he doesn’t intend to leave The Pit unless he avenges his brother’s death.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: While The Pit is still shocked about its new enemy Azer Kurtuluş, the Koçovalıs will call each other to account their losses. İdris will surprisingly gather the Koçovalı brothers to struggle side by side just like the old days. While Uluç’s betrayal shocks everyone, Damla will get dragged to a dead-end and this will get them close with Cumali. In the meantime, Yücel will visit Azer and will make a plan to destroy the Koçovalıs. Yücel will cross paths with the Alligator and will make a shocking move that will mount the tension in The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Yamaç will go crazy when he receives the third black envelope. Everybody in the Pit will try to find Aliço. Yücel who steadily puts his plan in motion will form an alliance with Alligator. In the meantime, a mistake that Celasun had made in the past will lead Meke and himself to confront Azer. In the episode where the two of them will be in danger, the eagerly awaited Akın Koçovalı will finally count down the days to be released from prison. Cumali will do his best to be by Damla’s side after her father’s death while Damla will have to decide between two choices. A new loss after Sena and Akşın’s death will change everything in the Pit and will totally shift the balance.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: After their painful losses the Koçovalıs will feel happiness with Akın Koçovalı’s release from prison. But Akın’s arrival to the family will cause too many questions. Yücel will join forces with Azer and Alligator to destroy the Koçovalıs while Yamaç will be a step ahead with his unexpected plan. In the episode where the Pit will spread throughout Istanbul a new black envelope will raise the tension. The bombshell in the episode finale will drag the Pit to a brand new period where nothing will be the same.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Continuing the previous season. After shooting his father, Yamaç returns to get his revenge from the people who made him do this. While other family members mourn the death of their father in prison. Akin trying to prove himself worthy of running the Pit.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Yamaç will go after his enemies and he will also face Baykal’s daughter Efsun. Yamaç’s avenging plans will be highly anticipated while the unexpected moments he will share with Efsun will change everything for both of them. After İdris’s death and during Yamaç’s absence Karaca will try to look out for The Pit and will put herself in danger with Akın’s move. The viewers will be shocked when they see who she’s going to go for help. Cumali will ask Vartolu Salih’s help to avenge his father. As Cumali’s exciting moments will be a curiosity, Salih will make an unexpected move. Azer will take the test of his life in Adana where he went for his sister’s wedding.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Azer goes mad after his sister’s death and plans a move with Akın. Aliço is with his father but he will do whatever he can to go back to The Pit to Yamaç. Yamaç avenges all of his enemies one by one. Now it’s time to confront Crocodile. It will be highly anticipated whether Yamaç is going to kill Crocodile or not. We will also wait curiously to see his decision about Efsun. Meanwhile Vartolu is chasing his father’s murderer. He will deal with the danger that awaits him in the new jailhouse he’s transferred. Cumali breaks out of prison and goes after Striped Kenan who dissolved their partnership after İdris’s death. Yamaç follows his own plan unaware of the great danger that’s waiting for him.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: A mysterious person saves Yamaç from Azer, Akın and Alligator’s attack. Thinking that Yamaç is dead Azer will make a move to destroy the remaining Koçovalıs. We will be curious about how the imprisoned Koçovalıs will survive these attacks. Vartolu will get an unexpected help. The viewers will be touched by Aliço’s painful past, while he tries to reach Yamaç. Yamaç’s unexpected visits will lead him to the streets of The Pit. Akın’s reaction and Yamaç’s moves will be highly anticipated.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Yamaç’s return to The Pit will be greeted with excitement and cheers. Akın will try to stay calm but will make a plan that will arouse curiosity. Cumali will avenge Striped Kenan while Yamaç will be forced to make a new plan. He will ask Şenol’s help to start his plan. The game he will set up will leave us breathless. While counting days to get out of prison, the Koçovalıs will find themselves in an unexpected trap. Vartolu’s move in regards to an unexpected incident will shift the balance in the jail house. Efsun will be caught up in a dangerous game after finding out that Yamaç is alive. Azer will come to Yamaç with a shocking offer.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Tension will mount when Yamaç activates his plan of becoming stronger than everybody. Striped Kenan’s son Dağhan will ask help from Murtaza and will plan to attack the Koçovalıs in their weakest moment. When Yamaç and Cumali feel desperate in a time when they’re ready to protect their family, they will get an unexpected help. The game that the Koçovalıs play to get out of prison will leave us breathless. While the women of the Koçovalı family look forward to the day the men will be released, Vartolu’s move will mount the tension. Yamaç will kick Akın out after his countless mistakes and this will shift the balance in The Pit. Yamaç’s conversation with Vartolu will make them confront certain facts.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Yamaç will make a hard decision when he finds himself in an unexpected situation and will bring a guest to the Kocovalıs’ house. The things that will happen between Azer and Karaca after he kidnaps her to save his siblings will be highly anticipated. Being kicked out of The Pit by Yamaç is an unexpected blow for Akın. When Karaca gets kidnapped Akın will be cornered. While Aliço is having hard days under his father’s pressure, Yamaç and the neighborhood will try to decrypt Aliço’s mysterious message and will encounter the traps of Yavuz. Cumali will confront Dağhan and Murtaza. The moments that Murtaza comes face to face with Yamaç and Cumali will mount the tension. The Koçovalıs will walk together on the path to become stronger than anyone and will pass the point of no return.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: The surprising events will set up a big face-off between Yamaç, Selim and Akın. Akın is shocked at Yamaç’s words which cause him to separate from his family, as well as the Pit. Akın goes to Kutay. Kutay sees him as a brother, and will pay dearly for his disloyalty. Azer will find out that Yamaç is the one who saved Fadik. Selim will face Karaca to save his daughter. Cumali will test Murtaza’s loyalty, and this will cause a merger between certain forces. Yamaç will get back to work to save Aliço. While tension builds up between Aliço and Yavuz, the viewers will have a smile when Vartolu and Medet finally reunite. We will wait to find out if Yamaç will reach Aliço, as the shocking development between Yamaç and Nehir will catch the audience off guard.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Azer goes over to the Koçovalı’s residence as a guest to pick his mom up, and meets the Koçovalı family for the first time. Yamaç's saving Fadik will not prevent the Azer-Yamaç meeting. Despite the objections of Fadik and Efsun, the fight between Azer and Yamaç will be very exciting. Akın is at the point of no return; and when he asks for help from his old allies he will face his mom which will raise new questions. Cumali’s next move is highly anticipated, and a big surprise waits for Damla who gets information about him. Vartolu will get help from Celasun and Meke to get one more step closer to Ziya. The encounter between Vartolu and Ziya is highly anticipated.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Yamaç and Azer will have to take a break from fighting with Efsun’s intervention. Akın will try to find a way for his old allies to take him back. Yamaç tries to find out who saved him, and when Nehir pays a surprise visit to the Pit, he will get very confused. When Aliço comes back to his senses and asks for İdris, the whole family will once again have to face the fact that he is no longer around. Vartolu will get even more confused with the information he gets from Ziya, and what he will do to get a step closer to his father’s killer will be eagerly anticipated. While the residents of the Pit expect an attack on the neighborhood they will get hit from an unexpected direction. This will be followed by them making their move, and finding out about a surprising name against them.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: The kidnapping of the women comes as a shock to The Pit. The whole neighborhood is terrified and expects help from the Koçovalıs. While Azer and Efsun’s side gets crowded, the Koçovalıs will unexpectedly hit them with their usual breathtaking plan. The neighborhood will spread around Istanbul and help the Koçovalıs. Once again it will be revealed that The Pit is in Istanbul. While the neighborhood turns Istanbul upside down, Vartolu’s plans will be highly anticipated now that he’s out of prison. As the tension between Yamaç and Azer mounts, the Koçovalı men will find themselves in the middle of action packed moments.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: The person who saved Yamaç from Alligator will be a curiosity. The Koçovalı brothers will get together with Vartolu’s move. Azer will confront an unexpected character when he comes to The Pit to get his brother. Kemal and Metin will face danger when they go to save the women of The Pit with the help of Aliço. Azer will take Kemal in return for his brother. His encounter with the Koçovalıs will be highly anticipated. As the Koçovalı women follow up the developments in the neighborhood, Saadet’s unexpected decision will shock everybody. Vartolu is determined to go and find his father’s murderer. They will have an emotional confrontation with Yamaç.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Nobody will be able to stop Yamaç after the shocking incident in The Pit. Following Yamaç’s move, Azer will confront The Pit with the support that he gets. Yamaç’s reaction to Azer’s attack will be highly anticipated. An unexpected character will come to The Pit and support them. The surprising development between Yamaç and Nehir will drive Yamaç away from the Pit for a while. Vartolu and Medet will start their adventurous trip to Germany. The tension between Azer and Yamaç will mount and endanger the life of another member of the Koçovalı family.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Cumali will get shot during Azer’s attack. The Pit will anxiously wait for the good news about Cumali. The probability of losing another family member will lead Yamaç and Selim to plan an attack on Azer, but they will unexpectedly find Karaca in front of them. Sultan and Fadik will try to stop this war with the fear of losing another son. Unaware of these incidents, Vartolu will put himself in danger while trying to find his father’s murderer in Germany. While Cumali struggles to survive, Yamaç’s reckoning with their enemies will be breathtaking. At the end of the action packed moments Yamaç will finally learn who saved him.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Upon Mahsun’s comeback Yamaç will have a big confrontation with him. It will be highly anticipated whether Yamaç will forgive Mahsun who saved his life numerous times or not. After regaining consciousness Cumali will face danger and find Damla next to him. As Vartolu comes to the end of his adventure in Germany he will finally get what he was after. Karaca and Azer’s fights will attract the viewers. Azer’s hands are tied so Efsun makes a move. But the Koçovalıs will respond bravely. Yamaç has finally managed to bring his opponents to their knees with the help of The Pit. Now he’s going to find himself in the middle of a cruel world facing a merciless enemy.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: With Çağatay Erdenet’s entry to the game the cards will be drawn again. Yamaç’s response to Çağatay will be highly anticipated while Azer will surprise everyone by making a move before Yamaç. Efsun is the only person who knows the mysterious Erdenet family. She will be cornered with Çağatay’s unexpected visit. The Koçovalıs will look for a way to struggle with their new enemy while they try to pacify Cumali who’s trying to get Karaca out of Azer’s house. The moments that Karaca stands against Cumali will be breathtaking. Vartolu will meet someone on his way back from Germany who will raise questions about the past. Vartolu will finally learn who killed his father.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Çağatay takes Mahsun and Yücel along to meet with another Koçovalı after Yamaç’s last move. Çağatay tries to get Selim on his side. Selim’s response will be a curiosity. On one side Selim will try to stop Yamaç’s attacks, on the other side he will try to protect the neighborhood. The person who will ask for help will surprise everyone. As Yamaç continues his moves at full speed, a loss will shake him deeply. Selim will confront Yamaç to learn what he’s been hiding. The emotional confrontation of the brothers will deeply touch the viewers. Vartolu who knows the big secret will get ready to face Yamaç. Yamaç will face death with Çağatay’s ruthless plan.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Selim and Cumali will be terrified with the package that Çağatay has sent. While the two of them wait for good news about Yamaç, they will continue to challenge Çağatay in their own way. Çağatay’s counter move will leave the Koçovalı’s and The Pit in a tough spot. Damla will have to face her past accounts. The other person who will have to settle accounts with his past is Akın. Karaca will decide to take action after hearing the news from The Pit. Azer will confront her. Vartolu and Mahsun’s move will raise questions while the recent developments will be the beginning of a new game in The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: The anticipated confrontation will happen this week in The Pit. Yamaç who has been running away from the truth for months and Vartolu who has been chasing his father’s murderer will come face to face. The viewers will look forward to how Vartolu will call Yamaç to account. Vartolu will take Yamaç to a surprising journey to make him talk. Vartolu will ask for Medet’s help to activate his plan in The Pit. When Çağatay starts to have doubts about Yamaç he will leave Mahsun in a tough spot to be on the safe side. We will be curious about what Mahsun will do not to turn Yamaç in. After their journey, Yamaç and Vartolu will totally change. Yamaç’s unfinished revenge plan will be breathtaking. No one will be able to get in the way of the two brothers who have set their goals.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: As Çağatay continues to attack The Pit with all his power the Koçovalı women will be affected by his actions as well as the Koçovalı men. Now that Selim, Cumali and Akın are disabled; who will protect The Pit? As the people of The Pit become desperate, Çağatay puts a bounty on Yamaç. Yamaç and Vartolu, who is trying to protect him, are now the primary targets. They will play puss in the corner with those who attack them for money. The exciting action packed moments will thrill the viewers. Karaca is deeply affected by the recent developments in The Pit. She will get close with Azer who is trying to protect her.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: There will be a big confrontation between Yamaç and his brothers Selim and Cumali. In the meantime, the Koçovalı brothers will try to get away from Çağatay’s men. Emmi’s struggle for life will deeply affect the neighborhood. Çağatay will make his move against The Pit at the most unexpected time. The moments that Çağatay enters The Pit will be breathtaking while a big surprise awaits Yamaç.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Being cornered with Çağatay’s moves, Yamaç will take Cumali and Selim and come back to the neighborhood. Selim will try to find a business opportunity to solve the financial problems of the neighborhood. On the other hand, Yamaç and Vartolu will try to put together the scattered pieces of the family. Fadik will visit Sultan after noticing the intimacy between Azer and Karaca. Karaca will have to make a tough decision. Going back home after a long time, Vartolu will have to give answers to Sultan about the killer of his father. Damla’s surprising news for Cumali will be thrilling. Yamaç who has to fill his father’s space, will try another way to protect The Pit and his family and will make a surprising move.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Yamaç doesn’t give up on resisting Çağatay. He will find new allies when he can’t get support from his brothers. But with Yamaç’s wish Vartolu will make a move to find the source of the problems in the neighborhood. On one side Çağatay will test Selim and Cumali with their worse fear and on the other side he will give Yamaç a new assignment. This assignment will prove Yamaç’s loyalty and force him to make a difficult choice.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: The Koçovalı family will be shaken with what Cumali and Damla go through. Yamaç will get a surprising offer while being kept by the police. The whole neighborhood will take action to protect Cumali who is on the move to kill Çağatay; but nobody will be able to stand on his way. Cumali’s attack on Çağatay will be breathtaking. Efsun will make a critical move to help Yamaç gain leverage against Çağatay. Vartolu will have hard times as he settles his accounts with a former enemy. Yamaç’s final game to destroy Çağatay will be highly anticipated.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Yamaç will step by step put an end to Çağatay Erdenet with the help of reporter Emir and police officer Erkan. But Vartolu will also have to sacrifice something. As Yamaç’s plan is working an unexpected person will help Cumali who is in a tough spot because of Çağatay’s men. Yamaç’s strategy against Celasun’s information about Karaca will be anticipated. The Koçovalı’s will start to work hard to put the neighborhood back together. But the Erdenet’s will not let the Koçovalı’s go despite their serious damage. With Arık Böke Erdenet’s arrival nothing will ever be the same for the Koçovalı’s and the Erdenet’s.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: The newscast that written by Emir about Erdenet family will once again bring The Pit and Erdenet family face to face. As Yamaç and Arık share their trump cards, Yamaç draws the attention of Cengiz Erdenet. While Cengiz, who will change all the balances in the war between Erdenet family and The Pit, makes an important decision about Yamaç. Arık's next move will bring Yamaç face to face with the thing he is most afraid to face. While the wedding preparations continue in the house of the Koçovalı family, the secret plans Karaca has set up to determine her own destiny will affect the lives of everyone, including Azer.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: While The Pit is shaken by the news of Yamaç's shooting, this will not be the only bad news that awaits the Koçovalılar. The whole family will be shocked when they find out why Cumali shoot Yamaç. Cengiz Erdenet, who sees the shooting of Yamaç as an opportunity, he will continue his work with Arık, but this time they will encounter an unexpected, mysterious person. While Yamaç is kidnapped and healed by a surprise name, Cumali will announce a new era in the Pit. During all this turmoil, Karaca will choose to draw her own destiny and will make a decision that will change their lives with Azer.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Leaving his neighborhood and house, Yamaç takes refuge in Efsun. While Nehir, who sees them together, makes a decision that will affect the lives of all of them. While Arık and Seren pursue their mysterious, Arık's life will suddenly be in danger. Cengiz will be one step closer to persuading Yamaç to stand by his side by collaborating with a surprise name. The people of The Pit and Koçovalılar, who understand once again the greatness of the enemy with an unexpected attack, will come together to protect their neighborhood. But this will not be the only surprise that awaits the Koçovalılar. Karaca, who is about to marry the man he loves, will make the hardest decision between her love and her family.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Yamaç will be tested once more with the Erdenetler' raid on The Pit. This move, in which Cengiz has showed his strength, will deeply affect The Pit. Yamaç will have to make a choice to protect his family, and his choice will be the beginning of a war with his family. Arık, whose life is in danger, is trying to get out of the plot he fell into, and two surprise names will help him. Everyone's life will change at the end of the confrontation between Azer and Karaca.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Cumali, who learns that Yamaç has taken the side of Cengiz, will attack Erdenetler with all the power of The Pit to punish him. People of The Pit will hit the Erdenetler in their own way at unexpected moment. Yamaç will make a move to solve the problem with Erdenetler, because if he does not stop this war, The Pit will be dragged into destruction. While Yamaç is planning a strategy with Vartolu to achieve this goal, Makbule will find a strong ally and take action to kill Yamaç. Cumali, who is trying to fix the cemetery in the neighborhood, will unwittingly learn a truth about his family.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Yamaç will realize for the first time after his last move that he has an enemy at least as smart as himself. Yamaç, who had to protect Arık with the will of Cengiz, will also enter into a breathtaking struggle with Arık to protect The Pit. Yamaç will seek help from Vartolu in order to accomplish the challenge he has taken. Efsun will get a help of an unexpected old ally. Cumali’s last move against Erdenetler will put The Pit, Yamaç and Erdenetler in a situation that can’t be overcome.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: When Yamaç takes action to protect The Pit, he will find The Pit which is preventing him again. When Yamaç pursues the kidnapping of Arık to acquit Cumali, he will be one step closer to the mysterious man Nedim is working with. Vartolu, on the one hand, will help Yamaç, on the other hand, he will continue to work so that the family does not blame Yamaç more. Yamaç will take action to reveal Nedim's true identity.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Seeing that his family is in danger with Cengiz's move, Yamaç will make a move that will surprise even Cengiz. As Vartolu and Yamaç are about to take action to deal with Cengiz and protect The Pit, all their plans will change with a surprise news. The things that Karaca will say about the death of Azer will shock Koçovalı family. After fulfilling the duty of Cengiz, Yamaç will have to reunite with an old enemy.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: Yamaç, who meets Çağatay again, will create a breathtaking plan to get rid of him and to calm Cumali’s anger. Cumali, whose burden has increased due to what happened in the neighborhood and what Karaca told the family, will give a critical decision. Selim will take the first step to lead The Pit.

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: After the confrontation with Efsun, Cumali was devastated by what he learned but then will take action once again for The Pit. Yamaç will receive a collaboration offer against Çağatay from someone he does not expect. While Yamaç will be happier than he has been for a long time with the good news he has received, Efsun will experience a great destruction because of what she witnessed.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Sefa attacks The Pit with the support of Erdenetler and his father Namık. This sudden attack will bring the family back together. A small gesture by the Sultan will set Yamaç in motion and Yamaç will remember again what it means to be Kocovali.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Cengiz and Çağatay took action to intimidate Yamaç, who had a big rest against Cengiz Erdenet. However, it will not go as they wanted with a plan that Yamaç had previously set up. Although the disagreements between the family seem to end with Yamaç's return home, no one realizes that one of them is coming to an end.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: After learning that the title deeds are in the hands of Çağatay, Yamaç will join forces with a surprise name. With this new ally, Yamaç will overturn Çağatay's plans against Cengiz and Ogeday. As Selim prepares to leave all his past behind and start a new life, he will face an unexpected threat.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: Koçovalı family is deeply shaken by the great loss they suffered. Yamaç, who vowed to take his revenge, will attack Cengiz at an unexpected moment. With the return of Ogeday, Çağatay, who lost the big trump card in his hand, will seek ways to turn things in his favor.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Yamaç, who striked a great blow to Cengiz, will try to ensure the safety of Nehir, unaware that Efsun is held captive by Erdenetler. Kocavalilar, who took action to avenge Selim, will meet their new enemy-Kulkan Erdenet.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Kulkan, who has recently joined the war between the Koçovali and the Erdenet families, will confront Çukur in places they have never expected, and will continue to hold Nehir and Efsun hostage. Nehir and Efsun, who have joined their forces, will take action to get rid of the Erdenets. Nedim, who has been following Çukur from afar for a while, will have a surprise request from the Koçovali family. Yamaç, who is one step closer to ending Cengiz Erdenet, will once again face a very difficult choice with Kulkan's unexpected move.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: As the Koçovalis and Çukur take action to save Efsun and Nehir, Yamaç will face a tough test. What happens in these moments of breath holding will be a matter of curiosity. Cengiz will stand up again with the help of Kulkan after the last events he experienced. Filled with anger more than ever before, the Erdenets will put the whole Çukur in great danger with the moves they make without slowing down. Yamaç, who deals with the surprise developments in the neighborhood while fighting the Erdenets on the one hand, will put into effect his plan to push Cengiz into a corner. At the end of the action-packed moments, the Koçovalis will take the first step to bring a surprise name from the Erdenet family.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: When the Koçovans, who caused Cengiz to suffer great losses, return to the neighborhood, they will encounter an unexpected sight.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Yamaç, which continues unabated to bring the end of the Erdenet's, will carry out a big attack to reach the next target. During this breathtaking action, what happened to Yamaç and Çukur will be a matter of curiosity. While the guard wall around him is getting weaker and weaker, Cengiz finds the solution to draw Çagatay back to his side, while Çagatay's game will cause surprising developments. After the death of Ogeday, Kulkan, angry with Gengiz, will be offered help from a place he does not expect. At the end of the action-packed moments, Koçovali will continue their revenge by bringing the end of a name from the Erdenet family.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: While the Koçovali's will continue their revenge plans by targeting Kulkan and Çagatay, after the death of Cengiz Erdenet, Çagatay's new move, which will put Çukur in great danger, will tie the hands of the Koçovali's. The surprise meeting that Vartolu will hold in Afghanistan will be eagerly awaited. As Yamaç faces the danger of losing his loved ones once again, the plan that Çagatay and Kulkan made with the mysterious man will bring another Koçovali face to face with death.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: After Akin, the life-threatening continues for Emmi and Aliço, and the new explosion to be experienced in the neighborhood will bring everyone's hearts to their mouths. While the Koçovali's will heal the wounds in Çukur, they will go after the Erdenets. The mind-filled plan established by Vartolu, who met with Uncle Cumali, will be breath-taking. While the developments in the house of the Koçovanli's regarding Efsun will be a new turning point for everyone, the new revenge plan of the Koçovali's will prepare the end of one of the Erdenet family.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: While Yamaç thinks that he will finally take a breath after Çagatay's death, he will be very upset when he learns that Efsun is leaving the house and will immediately start looking for her. With Akin and Yasmin's wedding preparations, Koçovali will take a short break from the war. The first wedding organized by the Koçovali after a long time will cause a tense wait. Vartolu, who learns that it is finally time to return home, will encounter an unexpected surprise on his journey to Çukur with Uncle Cumali. Learning that Efsun was kicked out of the house by his mother and kidnapped by Kulkan, Yamaç will go after Kulkan in anger. The result of the breathtaking encounter will surprise everyone.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Whether Yamaç will be able to return from the place where he was held by Kulkan in Afghanistan will be eagerly awaited.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: While the details of the new order that Uncle has established in the neighborhood are gradually emerging, the difference between those next to him and those against him will be clearly seen.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Vartolu, who learned what Yamaç went through, will take action to find Kulkan. Uncle, who learns Vartolu's intention, will use his own trump card and make a move that will surprise everyone.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: After seeing the sights in Çukur, Yamaç will choose his side by going against Uncle. This will be the beginning of a brand new era in Çukur.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: The unnamed war between Yamaç and Uncle will become more evident. This situation will bring Vartolu and Yamaç face to face again as it was years ago.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: As the tension between Yamaç and Uncle escalates, the war between the two sides will now become official. The circumcision wedding of Vartolu's son will bring both sides together.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: While Yamaç and Efsun's confrontation will bring emotional moments, the conflict between Uncle and Yamaç will bring Vartolu and Yamaç face to face.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: The tension between Yamaç and Vartolu will affect everyone. Uncle will trap someone he suspects with his game to find the informant who helped Yamaç.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Unable to stop Yamaç, the ropes will eventually stretch between Uncle and Vartolu, and Vartolu will take action to stop Yamaç. One of the main characters of Çukur will say goodbye to Çukur.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: Karaca, who could not hear from Celasun, will obtain important information thanks to the clue he has been following. This information brings Uncle and Karaca face to face.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: Vartolu, who was hit by Yamaç's games, will take the ropes this time. Taking action to reduce Uncle's power, Yamaç will be surprised by Vartolu's clever game.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Uncle will break all the ties between Vartolu and Yamaç with the new game he will set up. While Yamaç makes a clever plan to protect his loved ones, he will avenge another person.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: While Koçovans mourn Emmi's death; With the support of Efsun, Yamaç will take action to show Vartolu the true face of Uncle.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Çukur, who learns what happened to Karaca and Celasun, will be mourned. The Koçovans are once again tested the pain of death. As the accounts of past begin to close one by one, everyone will have to face the price of their mistakes.

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: While both Koçovans and Çukur are at peace after a long time, Uncle's move will change everything.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: While the surprise attack of those who stayed in Çukur on Uncle is breathtaking, Yamaç's last move, who thinks he has no other choice to protect the family and Çukur, will affect everyone deeply.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: While the Koçovali family and Çukur are giving the biggest test of their lives, the storm will break for the last time. With an unforgettable goodbye, everything will change forever for Çukur.
